on_board: ULSD: COT3 P/S, COT4 P/S (line L2)
Jet A-1: COT1 P/S, COT2 P/S (line L1)
Jet A-1: COT1 P/S, COT2 P/S (line L1)

cleaning_rules: JET->ULSD: drain and strip (a lighter, cleaner product before diesel)
JET->GASOLINE: drain and strip (jet residue is acceptable in gasoline)
JET->NAPHTHA: drain and strip (jet residue is acceptable in naphtha)
GASOLINE->NAPHTHA: drain and strip (similar light products)
NAPHTHA->GASOLINE: drain and strip (similar light products)
GASOLINE->ULSD: water wash (gasoline residue would lower the diesel's flash point)
NAPHTHA->ULSD: water wash (naphtha residue would lower the diesel's flash point)
ULSD->GASOLINE: water wash (diesel residue raises the gasoline's final boiling point and colour)
ULSD->NAPHTHA: water wash (diesel residue spoils naphtha)
ULSD->JET: full wash (diesel may contain FAME (biodiesel), which is not allowed in jet fuel)
GASOLINE->JET: full wash (gasoline residue would lower the jet fuel's flash point)
NAPHTHA->JET: full wash (naphtha residue would lower the jet fuel's flash point)
same grade or no last cargo: no cleaning
anything else: water wash
